svg.title: Linux x64: peak resident memory, cold
svg.desc: Linux x64: peak resident memory, cold. peak resident memory: the complexity pack (8 rules at the new version, 8 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 348 MB, 0.1.5 334 MB; peak resident memory: the javascript pack (121 rules at the new version, 121 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 859 MB, 0.1.5 1,232 MB; peak resident memory: the node pack (37 rules at the new version, 37 at 0.1.5) on real code, 1 core pinned (RERAIL_THREADS=1), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 533 MB, 0.1.5 591 MB; peak resident memory: the node pack (37 rules at the new version, 37 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 658 MB, 0.1.5 634 MB; peak resident memory: the node pack (37 rules at the new version, 37 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned; a larger corpus: the rerail-repository corpus of the bar (conformance, packs, scripts, src, test: 2,312 files), 3 runs a side: New version 738 MB, 0.1.5 704 MB; peak resident memory: the node pack (37 rules at the new version, 37 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned; a smaller corpus: src/ of the same commit with package.json and tsconfig.json (226 files), 3 runs a side: New version 647 MB, 0.1.5 632 MB; peak resident memory: the node pack (37 rules at the new version, 37 at 0.1.5) on real code, 8 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=8), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 768 MB, 0.1.5 629 MB; peak resident memory: the rerail pack (34 rules at the new version, 34 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 494 MB, 0.1.5 494 MB; peak resident memory: the rust pack (33 rules at the new version, 33 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 472 MB, 0.1.5 493 MB; peak resident memory: the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 1 core pinned (RERAIL_THREADS=1), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 477 MB, 0.1.5 519 MB; peak resident memory: the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 595 MB, 0.1.5 578 MB; peak resident memory: the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned; a larger corpus: the rerail-repository corpus of the bar (conformance, packs, scripts, src, test: 2,312 files), 3 runs a side: New version 667 MB, 0.1.5 713 MB; peak resident memory: the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned; a smaller corpus: src/ of the same commit with package.json and tsconfig.json (226 files), 3 runs a side: New version 585 MB, 0.1.5 483 MB; peak resident memory: the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 8 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=8), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 656 MB, 0.1.5 567 MB
